outline:
開課：機電、製科所合開（上學期）(含一般生、在職生)
本課程說明RFID系統架構，技術、編碼、和應用標準，資訊系統，效益評估，隱私權問題，及各領域或產業的創新應用和案例。

09/24		Holiday
10/01		Technology overview
10/08		Advantage, limitation, Application types
10/15		RJ-Retail/CPG, Privacy/Security
10/22		Quiz, RJ-Healthcare/Pharma, EPC and standard
10/29		RJ-Chemical, Team project meeting, project plan due
11/05		 RJ-Manufacturing, RFID vs Barcode, RFID implementation strategy
11/12		Midterm

12/02		 RJ-Packaging/Labeling, project status, special topics
12/09		 RJ-Apparel/Footwear, special topics, project report due
12/16		Quiz, team presentations
12/24		Trip to test lab
12/31		Team presentations
01/07		Team presentations
01/14		Final

Mid-term      30%
